title: Re-choosing Substitute from the overflow menu wipes the open edit-trio's typed values
evidence:
RefcheckSubstitute -> #(
          Model(
            ..menu_closed,
            refcheck_edit: dict.insert(
              model.refcheck_edit,
              call_id,
              prefill_refcheck_edit(model, call_id, RefcheckEditSubstitute),
            ),
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
detail: Objected/Unreachable rows render both the body substitute button and the ⋯ menu entry (view_overflow is independent of edit state). Choosing the menu entry while the §8.2 edit is open unconditionally re-inserts an EMPTY prefill, discarding typed referee PII (the N1 per-row dict protects across rows, not this within-row path).
recommended_fix: In the RefcheckSubstitute/RefcheckCorrect arms, only insert the prefill when dict.get(model.refcheck_edit, call_id) is Error; otherwise leave the entry untouched.
